text: 兔子。兔子的耳朵长长的，蹦蹦跳跳真可爱。
style: A gentle, warm adult female voice reading a picture book to a toddler. Use clear, standard Mainland Chinese Putonghua with precise four tones, natural neutral tones, and clear zh/ch/sh versus z/c/s. No Taiwanese Mandarin, Hong Kong or Cantonese accent, no exaggerated erhua. Calm and affectionate, lightly smiling, never whispery, breathy, theatrical or babyish. Read slowly but naturally, about 3 Chinese syllables per second. Pause briefly after the animal name. Read the text verbatim, no extra words, music or effects.
